summary_1line: Kuvalaswa kills the fire-breathing Asura Dhundhu, gains the name Dhundhumara, and Yudhishthira then asks about the difficult virtue of chaste wives and duty.

image_candidates.scene_text: The giant Asura Dhundhu rises from the desert sands, breathing world-ending flames as the sons of Kuvalaswa attack him with weapons.
King Kuvalaswa stands before the blazing demon while a torrent of water streams from his body to quench the inferno.
After slaying Dhundhu, Kuvalaswa bows with folded hands as gods and rishis appear in the sky offering him boons.
